D.comparison: no gymnasium with a physical director

cells.quote: It is gratifying to notice that most of our normal schools have gymnasiums in charge of physical directors. Fifty-eight are thus supplied, while 20 report that they are lacking in this particular. The returns indicate that too few students participate in this form of exercise and that efforts should be made to increase the number.
cells.note: The questionnaire reports school-level provision and overall athletics participation, but does not provide athletics outcomes separately for schools with versus without gymnasiums; therefore no comparative direction or causal design can be coded.
